# Suqya Institute

> Suqya Institute is an online Quran academy: live one-to-one Quran and Arabic lessons with male and female teachers, including ijazah holders and Al-Azhar graduates. Parents follow every lesson in the portal. The first lesson is a free trial.

Lessons are one to one on Zoom, scheduled in the family's own time zone, for children and adults, including learners who do not speak Arabic.

## Programs

- [Online Quran classes for kids in the UK](https://suqyainstitute.com/online-quran-classes-for-kids-uk): live one-to-one lessons set in UK time around the school week.
- [Online Quran classes for kids in the USA](https://suqyainstitute.com/online-quran-classes-for-kids-usa): live one-to-one lessons scheduled in your local US time zone.
- [Quran for non-Arabic speakers](https://suqyainstitute.com/quran-for-non-arabic-speakers): reading, Tajweed, meaning and Arabic for children and adults who don't speak Arabic.
- [Tajweed for kids](https://suqyainstitute.com/tajweed-for-kids): letter pronunciation, Tajweed rules and fluent reading with ijazah-holding teachers.
- [Noorani Qaida online](https://suqyainstitute.com/noorani-qaida-online): Arabic letters, joined forms, vowels and first words for complete beginners.
- [Islamic Studies for kids](https://suqyainstitute.com/islamic-studies-for-kids): a structured, levelled curriculum in English, from age 4.

## Getting started

- [Free Quran trial class](https://suqyainstitute.com/free-quran-trial-class): a free one-to-one trial on Zoom; the teacher assesses the learner's level and the family gets a reviewed summary and a recommended plan. No payment, no commitment.
- [Apply](https://suqyainstitute.com/apply): the application form to book the free trial.
